scope: partial reproduction, newly trained CNN, Kernel SHAP and adapted image LIME
image_selection: random true source class correctly classified as source
mask_rule: descending phi_source-phi_target, strictly positive only; stable pixel-index tie break
explanation_output: two columns of original ten-way probabilities, unrenormalized

lime.features: one binary feature per nonzero pixel

metric: delta log(p_target/p_source), computed exactly using pre-softmax logits
random_rule: for each method/image, same actual removed pixel count; choose uniformly among nonzero pixels

training.selection: highest validation accuracy, first epoch on ties

differences_from_paper: new fixed sample of correctly classified 8s
LIME adaptation uses official LimeBase with specified modern settings
exact top-k tie break instead of author's strict threshold
sampling budget may differ, see samples_per_method_per_image
